data.description:
## Context / Problem

Discovered from majestic-depilatory-beetle. The advisory `sweep (windows)` job runs a maintained subset held green: tests known to fail on Windows are deselected through `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/file-locks.args`. This bug owns that file: 19 tests in 15 modules, from the 5 scheduled runs at `b4e0d01b649` (2026-11-15/16).

Observed signatures: deleting or replacing read-only git object files raises `WinError 5` (`test_pinned_ticket_view.py`, `test_ci_snapshot_fixture_cleanup.py`, `test_authorship_batched_ticket_map_7084.py`); removing a directory that is a process's cwd raises `WinError 32` (`test_detached_child_cwd.py`); concurrent writers onto one target lose a write with `PermissionError` (`test_unique_cache_writes.py`, `test_completion_verdict_cache.py`, `test_plan_review.py`, `test_bridge_state_atomic_write_concurrency.py`, `test_alert_store_concurrency.py`). 9 of these 19 failed in some of the 5 runs and passed in others; all 9 are concurrency tests. This is the file-lock behaviour the advisory job exists to detect, and the concurrent-writer cases are product behaviour.

## Approach

Reproduce each first: run the module repeatedly on a Windows runner (`workflow_dispatch`) to get a deterministic failure before changing code. Then, for read-only git objects, clear the read-only bit before deleting; for concurrent replace onto one target, handle the Windows sharing violation in the product writer with a bounded retry; for the cwd case, fix the test's directory lifetime.

## Scope

The failing product or test code for this class, plus `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/file-locks.args` (remove each fixed line; delete the file and its `@` reference in `.github/workflows/test.yml` once empty).

## Testing

POSIX: the touched tests still pass under `make verify`. Windows: repeated `sweep (windows)` runs on main after the change pass with the removed lines no longer deselected.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The class's root cause is recorded per signature on this ticket with the evidence that confirmed it.
- [ ] Every line removed from `file-locks.args` names a test that passed in 3 consecutive `sweep (windows)` runs on main after the fix (run ids recorded in a comment).
- [ ] `sweep (windows)` concludes `success` on those runs.
data.title: Windows sweep: open handles, read-only git objects and concurrent replace raise PermissionError (19 tests)
